Hi Brad! I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times when BOTH are free for a 30-minute meeting next week:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00 (slots at 9:00 or 9:30)
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00 (slots at 13:00 or 13:30), 16:30-17:00 (slot at 16:30)
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00 (slots at 15:00 or 15:30)
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30 (slot at 10:00)
- Friday: 11:00-12:00 (slots at 11:00 or 11:30)

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against these time slots and let me know which slots work for all four partners. I'll create the booking once we find a mutual time.
